description: A tall and slender humanoid lacking skin and any normalcy of countenance.  Wings of muscle curl forth from its back and a third eye dominates the forehead.

special_attacks.monster_message: The flesh angel's third eyes gazes at %3$s malevolently.

special_attacks.miss_msg_u: %1$s claws at you, but you dodge!
special_attacks.miss_msg_npc: %1$s tries to claw at <npcname>, but they dodge!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_u: %1$s claws at your %2$s, but fails to penetrate armor.
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_npc: %1$s tries to claw at <npcname>, but fails to penetrate armor.
